request.initial_prompt: Patrice, home on furlough, lapped warm milk with me in the bar MacMahon. Son of the wild goose, Kevin Egan of Paris. My father's a bird, he lapped the sweet _lait chaud_ with pink young tongue, plump bunny's face. Lap, _lapin._ He hopes to win in the _gros lots_. About the nature of women he read in Michelet. But he must send me _La Vie de Jésus_ by M. Léo Taxil. Lent it to his friend.

Patrice, home on furlough, lapped warm milk with me in the bar, MacMan.
Son of the wild goose, Kevin Egan of Paris.
He lapped the sweet late show with pink young tongue, plump bunny's face.
Lap lapin', he hopes to win in the grows lots.
About the nature of women he read in michelet.
But he must send me la vie de jesus by M. leotaxil.
